$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. AuthorityDecisionRecord per FB-RAT-AUTH-001..007 (GRANT MODEL 'Decisions:' list — allow / deny / require confirmation / require stronger authority / allow with redaction or sandbox) and the constellation-wide invariant that policy decisions are deterministic, locally logged, and unit-tested against privilege-escalation fixtures. Typically carried as the `payload` of a ContractEnvelope<AuthorityDecisionRecord> (see schemas/common/envelope.schema.json), inheriting schemaVersion/producer/createdAtUtc — `decisionId` below is this object's own FB-RAT-COM-002 stable ID. Decision records are append-only (FB-RAT-COM-006, same rule as any other event/receipt in this constellation): a later re-evaluation of the same request is a NEW record with a new `decisionId`, never an edit of this one.
title: AuthorityDecisionRecord
description: The evaluated outcome of one authority check: a principal requested one capability against one resource, and a policy engine decided ALLOW, DENY, REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION, REQUIRE_STRONGER_AUTHORITY, or ALLOW_WITH_REDACTION_OR_SANDBOX (the five variants also encoded as contracts/kotlin/AuthorityContracts.kt's `AuthorityDecision` sealed interface). This is the audit/log shape, not the policy engine itself — the engine's matching logic (walking Principal lineage, matching Grant.resourceScope/capabilityIds/expiresAtUtc, applying default-deny) is described in docs/ratified/CAPABILITY_AUTHORITY_MODEL.md and is not fully expressible as a JSON Schema structural constraint; this schema constrains the SHAPE of the resulting record and the small set of per-outcome field requirements that ARE structurally checkable.

decisionId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this decision record (FB-RAT-COM-002). Append-only per FB-RAT-COM-006 — never mutated or reused after issue.

requestObjectId.description: Back-reference to the objectId (FB-RAT-COM-002) of whatever operation/request this decision concerns — e.g. an ExecutionRequest.id (schemas/execution/request.schema.json), a git-history-rewrite operation id, a release-publish operation id. Deliberately generic across domains: any operation anywhere in the constellation that needs an authority check produces exactly one AuthorityDecisionRecord per check, referencing itself here.

requestedCapabilityId.description: The single capability-ids.v1.json capability being requested for this check. An operation needing multiple capabilities produces multiple AuthorityDecisionRecords, one per capability — this keeps each record's outcome unambiguous (never 'partially allowed').

requestedResourceScope.description: The specific resource instance the request targets — typically narrower than (or equal to, never wider than) whatever Grant.resourceScope ultimately matched it, e.g. a single file path matching a Grant's wider FILE_GLOB pattern.

matchedGrantId.description: The Grant.grantId (schemas/authority/grant.schema.json) this decision was evaluated against, or `null` when no grant matched at all (the FB-RAT-AUTH-003 default-deny path — see the if/then below requiring `reasonCode: AUTHORITY_DEFAULT_DENY` to be the only reasonCode paired with a null matchedGrantId.) Required non-null for ALLOW, REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION, and ALLOW_WITH_REDACTION_OR_SANDBOX (see the if/then below) — every outcome that grants some authority, even conditionally, MUST cite the grant it derived that authority from (FB-RAT-COM-012 'no contract bypass' applied to this domain).

outcome.description: The GRANT MODEL's five decision variants, verbatim. Mirrors contracts/kotlin/AuthorityContracts.kt's `AuthorityDecision` sealed interface 1:1 — an exhaustive `when` over that sealed interface is the compile-time guarantee every variant here has runtime handling.

reasonCode.description: Stable machine-readable reason code (same SCREAMING_SNAKE convention as ErrorEnvelope.code, schemas/common/error.schema.json) — stable across releases, never reused for a different meaning once retired. This contract version's initial vocabulary (open, not a closed enum, same rationale as ErrorEnvelope.code): AUTHORITY_DEFAULT_DENY (FB-RAT-AUTH-003, no grant matched), AUTHORITY_GRANT_MATCH (an ALLOW backed by an exact grant match), AUTHORITY_CHILD_EXCEEDS_PARENT (FB-RAT-AUTH-004, requesting principal's lineage never held sufficient rung), AUTHORITY_TRANSITIVE_DELEGATION_REJECTED (FB-RAT-AUTH-007), AUTHORITY_PURPOSE_MISMATCH (FB-RAT-AUTH-005, purpose-bound grant used outside its declared purpose), AUTHORITY_TARGET_MISMATCH (FB-RAT-AUTH-005, resourceScope does not cover the requested resource), AUTHORITY_GRANT_EXPIRED (FB-RAT-AUTH-005, `expiresAtUtc` has passed), AUTHORITY_GRANT_REVOKED, AUTHORITY_PRINCIPAL_NOT_ACTIVE (Principal.status is not ACTIVE), AUTHORITY_RUNG_INSUFFICIENT (paired with REQUIRE_STRONGER_AUTHORITY), AUTHORITY_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED (paired with REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION), AUTHORITY_REDACTION_OR_SANDBOX_APPLIED (paired with ALLOW_WITH_REDACTION_OR_SANDBOX).

requiredRung.description: Required non-null only when `outcome` is REQUIRE_STRONGER_AUTHORITY (see the if/then below) — the rung the requester would need to hold for this decision to become ALLOW.

confirmationPromptRef.description: Required non-null (and non-blank) only when `outcome` is REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION (see the if/then below) — a pointer to what MUST be shown to the user before this action proceeds (e.g. a UI copy key, or a short description string). FB-RAT-COM-009 accessibility: whatever this resolves to at render time MUST carry text semantics, not rely on color/icon/haptic/position alone, same rule as ErrorEnvelope.userMessage.

redactionOrSandbox.description: Required non-null only when `outcome` is ALLOW_WITH_REDACTION_OR_SANDBOX (see the if/then below) — which of the two mitigations was applied and a human-readable detail of what, specifically.

policyVersion.description: Version of the authority policy/ruleset this decision was evaluated under (same spirit as schemas/loops/registries/loop-validation-rules.v1.json's `rulesetVersion` — 'a validation report MUST include this rulesetVersion... so decisions remain reproducible/auditable'). Required so 'policy decisions are deterministic' is checkable after the fact: re-running the same request against the same `policyVersion` MUST yield the same outcome.

decidedAtUtc.description: UTC instant this decision was made (FB-RAT-COM-004).

evidenceLinks.description: FB-RAT-COM-008 provenance evidence links — e.g. the Principal lineage chain (list of principalId) actually walked, or a reference to the specific Grant fields compared. Optional because a simple ALLOW/DENY on an exact single-grant match may need no more evidence than `matchedGrantId` itself already carries.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

AuthorityRung.description: Duplicated from schemas/authority/grant.schema.json's $defs/AuthorityRung per this repo's established convention of duplicating small shared sub-shapes across schema files in the same domain (see docs/ratified/COMMON_CONVENTIONS.md §5) — both copies MUST be kept in sync if this ladder changes.

kind.description: Duplicated from schemas/authority/grant.schema.json's $defs/ResourceScope (see docs/ratified/COMMON_CONVENTIONS.md §5); both copies MUST be kept in sync.

locator.description: Kind-specific identifier — see schemas/authority/grant.schema.json's $defs/ResourceScope.locator for the full per-kind description. Here it identifies the SPECIFIC resource instance the request targeted, not a pattern (a decision is always about one concrete instance, even when the matched Grant's own resourceScope.locator was a pattern like a FILE_GLOB).

mode.description: REDACTION: the action proceeds but sensitive content is stripped/masked first (e.g. a log excerpt with a secret pattern redacted before it leaves the device — see fixtures/execution/adversarial/receipt-secret-leak-in-log-excerpt for the sibling pattern this mitigates). SANDBOX: the action proceeds inside an isolated/bounded execution context that limits its effective authority regardless of what it attempts (e.g. an imported companion artifact's first activation run).

detail.description: Human-readable specifics of what was redacted or how the sandbox was bounded — never itself contains the redacted secret/content (same MUST-NOT-contain-secrets rule as ErrorEnvelope.detail, schemas/common/error.schema.json).
